metadata.title: टिपरा मोथा के मंत्री बिना विभाग के क्यों | Exclusive Interview with Animesh Debbarma
metadata.description: In a recent alliance between the TIPRA Motha party and the BJP in Tripura, two leaders from TIPRA Motha were sworn in as ministers. However, three days have passed without allocating departments to these new ministers, hinting at potential discord within the alliance. Animesh Debbarma, a senior leader and newly appointed cabinet minister, expressed apparent dissatisfaction with these developments in this interview with Chitrita Sanyal. His demeanour suggests that he is not entirely pleased with the current situation.
